mentions.name: eFlock Smart Poultry Tags
mentions.description: Smart RFID tags for poultry that let farmers count and identify all of the birds in their flock. The physical tags are being launched and will be sold on Amazon.
mentions.audience: Farmers who need to count and identify their poultry flock
mentions.source_excerpt: I am in the process of launching my poultry RFID tags, “eFlock Smart Poultry Tags”. They allow farmers to count and identify all of the birds that they have.

evidence.value: I am in the process of launching my poultry RFID tags, “eFlock Smart Poultry Tags”. They allow farmers to count and identify all of the birds that they have.
